summary: The note describes a fall 2023 series of wine and dine galas that pair regional specialties with local wines, starting September 10, 2023. It covers pairing, education, local economic benefits, sustainability, cultural exchange and networking, citing named organizers and events. The galas are presented as a way to promote regional identity and preserve culinary legacy.
one_line: Autumn 2023 wine and dine galas pair regional dishes with local vintages while supporting education, local economies, sustainability, and cultural exchange.
key_facts: The series of wine and dine galas kicks off on September 10, 2023.
The "Harvest Moon Feast" on September 20, 2023 is organized by culinary expert Jameson Green and sommelier Ava Clark.
Jameson Green pairs farm-reared poultry with a crisp local Chardonnay as an example of an immersive experience.
An October 7, 2023 gala in the vineyards of Napa Valley paired a peppery Zinfandel with a hearty beef stew.
Ava Clark says pairing is "about harmony and contrast" and that the right wine can elevate a dish.
Chef Nicolas Raymond's "Vine and Dine Symposium" on November 15, 2023 includes tasting sessions, cooking demos, and vintner talks.
Symposium attendees learn how terroir affects grape qualities and the resulting wine.
Philanthropist Elizabeth Harper arranged the "Autumn Ambrosia Gala" for October 29, 2023 to introduce small regional wine producers to a wider audience.
The "Eco-Gourmet Festival" on November 22, 2023, pioneered by environmentalist chef Leo McAdams, promotes sustainable practices and shorter farm-to-table distances that reduce carbon footprints.
"The Global Table," conceived by chef Amira Singh for December 5, 2023, combines regional dishes with international culinary techniques and local wines.
The galas also serve as networking occasions where business deals are toasted with the region's wines.
